candidate.title: scM&T-seq
candidate.scope: The scM&T-seq row of the assigned Illumina poster: single-cell methylome and transcriptome sequencing by physical mRNA/DNA separation, a Smart-seq2 transcriptome branch, and an scBS-seq DNA branch. The matching collection page 119 and Angermueller et al. (PMID 26752769) identify this implementation. Div-Seq, SCRB-Seq, and G&T-seq are separate neighboring rows in the attached context image, not depicted alternatives for this assigned card. Smart-seq2 and scBS-seq are components here. The Hu et al. scMT-seq/scRRBS assay mentioned by the catalogue is an unshown related method, not another target. Broad preparation blocks remain broad; primary text clarifies the library and readout interfaces without adding a laboratory recipe.

operations.label: On-bead transcriptome amplification with Smart-seq2

method_scopes.rationale: All recorded operations belong to the scM&T-seq row, with distinct local sequencing and alignment instances for its retained RNA and DNA branches. The card names this one target; page 119 repeats its heading, captions the matching schematic, and identifies Smart-seq2 plus scBS-seq. The Angermueller primary full text explicitly applies scBS-seq to genomic DNA physically purified using G&T-seq. G&T-seq supplies a separation component here and its neighboring MDA workflow is outside this target. The scBS-seq branch and common-cell fraction history distinguish this implementation from the unshown Hu scMT-seq/scRRBS workflow; broad similarity or the catalogue’s ambiguous name does not make them interchangeable.
